fields.description: Master switch. When unchecked the scheduled sync does nothing.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Base URL without a trailing slash. The store id and endpoint are appended.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Item Group used for POS menu items created automatically by the sync.
fields.label: POS Item Group

fields.description: What a store does with a Lithos item that has no ERPNext item, unless the store sets its own. Hold keeps the day out of ERPNext until the item is mapped in the Lithos Item Workbench. Suspense posts it to the suspense item. Auto-create makes a new POS- item (the old behaviour, not recommended).
fields.label: Unmapped Item Policy

fields.description: Placeholder item for stores on the Suspense policy. Map the real item in the Workbench, then re-post the day.
fields.label: Suspense Item

fields.description: Also hold a day when a sold item has no default BOM (D9). Leave off until recipe consumption (M6) goes live.
fields.label: Hold Days With Items Without a BOM

fields.description: The nightly run (02:00) also re-pulls this many earlier days. It posts any day still missing and flags a posted day whose Lithos total has changed.
fields.label: Look-back Days

fields.description: A failed day is retried hourly, waiting 1, 2, then 4 hours between tries.
fields.label: Retries for a Failed Day

fields.description: Email addresses, one per line. They get a summary when a scheduled run ends with failed, held or changed days.
fields.label: Alert Recipients
